content: Ethinyl estradiol can increase cyclosporine levels through an unknown mechanism. Close monitoring is recommended. Dabrafenib decreases the levels or effects of ethinyl estradiol by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are advised. Danazol may increase the levels or effects of ethinyl estradiol by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism, though the clinical significance is unclear. Close monitoring is suggested. Danicopan increases the levels or effects of ethinyl estradiol through other mechanisms, and caution is advised. Danicopan also increases plasma concentrations of BCRP substrates, so dose adjustments of these substrates may be necessary. Darunavir reduces the levels or effects of ethinyl estradiol by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism, potentially reducing the efficacy of hormonal contraceptives. Nonhormonal contraceptives are recommended. Close monitoring is recommended. Dexamethasone decreases the levels or effects of ethinyl estradiol by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism, reducing contraceptive efficacy. Nonhormonal contraceptives are recommended. Diazepam levels may be increased by ethinyl estradiol due to reduced metabolism, necessitating caution and monitoring.
